data.text: The academic program at The VIDYA School is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi. Our curriculum is thoughtfully aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP 2020) and National Curriculum Framework (NCF), providing a student-centric learning continuum from the Foundational Stage through Senior Secondary.

data.label: CBSE Board Pass Rate
data.subtext: Excellence across Secondary (Class X) & Senior Secondary (Class XII)

items.title: Classes Nursery to V
items.description: Activity-based, experiential learning focused on early literacy, numeracy, language discovery, art, and motor skill development.

items.title: Classes VI to VIII
items.description: Subject-specialized instruction across sciences, mathematics, humanities, computational thinking, and vocational arts.

items.title: Classes IX to XII
items.description: Rigorous academic preparation for CBSE Board Examinations, career counseling, pre-board evaluations, and competitive entrance coaching.
